dialogue.text: The first morning of the new school term -- and Aoi is already running late.
No, no, no -- not on the very first day!
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: fear

dialogue.text: Her breath caught in her throat as she skidded to a stop at the corner.
The road to school should have opened onto the shopping street.
Instead, a narrow stone path stretched ahead, damp with morning mist.
At the end of it stood a shrine gate she had never seen before.
...This wasn't here yesterday.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: surprise

dialogue.text: She turned back at once.
The corner behind her was gone, swallowed by pale white fog.
No way...
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: fear

dialogue.text: A bell rang somewhere ahead.
One clear note. Then another. Then a third.
I really don't have time for this.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: fear

dialogue.text: She said it softly, as if the mist might overhear.
When the fourth bell sounded, a girl was standing beneath the gate.
She wore an old school uniform, sleeves faded silver at the edges.
You're late again.
dialogue.speaker: Mizuki

dialogue.text: Again...?
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: surprise

dialogue.text: This morning keeps missing its first step.
dialogue.speaker: Mizuki

dialogue.text: I don't understand.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: surprise

dialogue.text: The other girl smiled, but it looked lonely more than kind.
Neither did I, the first time.
dialogue.speaker: Mizuki

dialogue.text: The first time?
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: surprise

dialogue.text: You've passed this gate three times already.
dialogue.speaker: Mizuki

dialogue.text: Aoi's fingers tightened around her school bag.
A memory flickered: tying her ribbon, checking the clock, stepping outside.
Then nothing. Just the rush of running, and this place.
...That's why I was late.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: surprise

dialogue.text: Because you keep choosing the shortest way.
dialogue.speaker: Mizuki

dialogue.text: It's just the route to school.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: neutral

dialogue.text: Not today. Today it wants something.
dialogue.speaker: Mizuki

dialogue.text: The mist stirred around the stones like breath.
From me?
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: surprise

dialogue.text: A name.
dialogue.speaker: Mizuki

dialogue.text: For a moment, Aoi almost laughed.
It came out instead as a small, shaky exhale.
You're asking me to tell my name to a road?
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: surprise

dialogue.text: To the morning. So it can let you go.
dialogue.speaker: Mizuki

dialogue.text: Aoi looked through the gate.
Beyond it, hidden in the dim, stood rows of weathered wooden tablets.
One of them was blank.
If I do this... I'll get to school?
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: fear

dialogue.text: Yes.
dialogue.speaker: Mizuki

dialogue.text: And if I don't?
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: fear

dialogue.text: You'll keep running until the first bell never comes.
dialogue.speaker: Mizuki

dialogue.text: Her stomach dropped.
Then, unexpectedly, she noticed the girl's hands.
They were pressed together so tightly they trembled.
...You couldn't leave either, could you?
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: sadness

dialogue.text: The smile on Mizuki's face thinned.
I forgot my own name a long time ago.
dialogue.speaker: Mizuki

dialogue.text: The words landed with a quiet weight.
Aoi stepped closer to the blank tablet.
Aoi Takase.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: neutral

dialogue.text: The mist drew back at once.
Sunlight poured through the gate in a pale gold sheet.
Then... if names matter...
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: neutral

dialogue.text: Can I give you one?
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: happiness

dialogue.text: Mizuki's eyes widened, glass-bright.
Why would you?
dialogue.speaker: Mizuki

dialogue.text: Because being left behind sounds lonely.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: sadness

dialogue.text: It was the longest sentence she'd said all morning.
Her voice stayed soft, but it did not shake this time.
...Mizuki.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: happiness

dialogue.text: A wind moved through the shrine, ringing the bell once.
The old uniform fluttered like paper in rain.
What a gentle name.
dialogue.speaker: Mizuki

dialogue.text: The path behind Aoi opened back into the ordinary street.
The shopping signs, the crossing light, the distant school clock.
Go on. You'll still make homeroom.
dialogue.speaker: Mizuki

dialogue.text: Will I see you again?
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: sadness

dialogue.text: If you're late tomorrow, I hope not.
dialogue.speaker: Mizuki

dialogue.text: Aoi let out a breath that almost became a laugh.
Right... I'll try not to be.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: happiness

dialogue.text: When she blinked, the gate was gone.
Only a narrow side alley remained, bright with morning.
Aoi touched her chest once, steadying her heartbeat, and started running again.
First day...
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: neutral

dialogue.text: Please be normal from here on.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: neutral
